title: Notifications
empty: No notifications yet. They appear here when you book, 15 minutes before each booking, if a booking is cancelled, and when you are made an administrator of a council.

type.booking_reminder: Starts in 15 minutes: {{facility}} at {{time}}. Have your QR ready.
type.booking_cancelled_by_council: We’re sorry: {{facility}} has been closed, so your booking on {{day}} at {{time}} was cancelled.
type.booking_cancelled_by_closure: We’re sorry: {{facility}} is closed from {{from}} to {{until}}, so your booking on {{day}} at {{time}} was cancelled.
type.booking_cancelled_by_staff: We’re sorry: {{council}} cancelled your booking at {{facility}} on {{day}} at {{time}}.
type.council_admin_granted: You are now an administrator of {{council}}. Open its administration from here or from your account menu.
type.issue_solved: The problem you reported at {{facility}} is fixed.
type.issue_rejected: The council looked at the problem you reported at {{facility}} and will not take it further.
type.rating_requested: How was {{facility}}? Rate it with 1 to 5 stars.
type.rating_requested_public: How was {{facility}}? Rate it, and the people who played with you.
type.resident_requested: {{name}} wants to be a resident of {{council}}.
type.resident_verified: {{council}} verified you as a resident: you can now book its residents-only facilities.
type.resident_rejected: {{council}} could not verify you as a resident. Phone the council if you think this is a mistake.
type.resident_revoked: {{council}} took back your verification as a resident: what you had booked at its residents-only facilities was cancelled.
